---
title: "Supplementary figure captions and assembly"
format: html
---

This is an author-review assembly, not the submission builder. It preserves vector
masters and records exact input hashes. Existing report generation stays quarantined.
Run the Python cell with the bundled PDF runtime, supplying a NEW output directory.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import csv, hashlib, io, json, sys, subprocess, re
from xml.sax.saxutils import escape
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter, Transformation
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet
from reportlab.platypus import Paragraph, Table, TableStyle
from reportlab.lib import colors
from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics
from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont
pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont('ReviewSans','/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf'))
pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont('ReviewBold','/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial Bold.ttf'))
pdfmetrics.registerFontFamily('ReviewSans', normal='ReviewSans', bold='ReviewBold', italic='ReviewSans', boldItalic='ReviewBold')

root = Path('/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment')
d = root / 'PRJEB79569/derived'
out = Path(sys.argv[1])
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
(out/'output/pdf').mkdir(parents=True)
snap = d/'manuscript_snapshot_2026-09-22_supplement_v1_source'
text = (snap/'accepted_preview.txt').read_text()
styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
styles['Normal'].fontSize = 10
styles['Normal'].leading = 14
styles['Normal'].fontName = 'ReviewSans'
W,H = 595.28,841.89
writer = PdfWriter()
manifest=[]
readers=[]  # Keep readers alive: pypdf uses object identity during cross-file merges.
review_buffer=io.BytesIO()
review_canvas=canvas.Canvas(review_buffer,pagesize=(W,H))
page_count=0
# Number and assemble figures in manuscript first-mention order.
display_order = [0, 3, 2, 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
reference_map_path=d/'supplementary_reference_reconciliation_2026-09-22/mapping.json'
reference_map={int(k):v for k,v in json.loads(reference_map_path.read_text())['old_to_new'].items()}
caption_titles = [
    'Original experimental system, cleaning sequence and sampling design',
    'Cross-omics community comparison',
    'Viral community composition across cleaning cycles',
    'Family-level 16S rRNA community composition',
    '16S rRNA community structure based on Bray-Curtis dissimilarities',
    '16S rRNA community structure based on Aitchison distances',
    'MAG contributions to treatment-downregulated biofilm-associated gene expression',
    'Modelled cleaning-score responses to suppression of 14 candidate MAGs',
    'Distribution of modelled cleaning-score responses across all MAGs',
]

def rows(path):
    with open(path) as f: return list(csv.DictReader(f, delimiter='\t'))

def record(path, role):
    path=Path(path)
    if not any(r['path']==str(path) for r in manifest):
        manifest.append({'path':str(path),'role':role,'bytes':path.stat().st_size,
                         'sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})

def para(c, content, x, y, width):
    p=Paragraph(content, styles['Normal']); _,h=p.wrap(width,700)
    if y-h < 40: raise ValueError('Text exceeds page')
    p.drawOn(c,x,y-h)
    return y-h-12

def remap_table_refs(body):
    def replace(m):
        old=[]
        for part in re.findall(r'S?\d+(?:[–-]S?\d+)?',m.group()):
            n=[int(x) for x in re.findall(r'\d+',part)]
            old.extend(range(n[0],n[-1]+1))
        labels=[f'S{reference_map[n]}' for n in sorted(old,key=reference_map.get)]
        label=labels[0] if len(labels)==1 else ', '.join(labels[:-1])+' and '+labels[-1]
        return ('Table ' if len(labels)==1 else 'Tables ')+label
    return re.sub(r'\bTables? S\d+(?:(?:[–-]|, | and )S?\d+)*',replace,body)

def page(title, body='', source=None, draw=None):
    global page_count
    c=review_canvas
    full_title = caption_titles[page_count]
    if page_count == 0:
        body = re.sub(r'^' + re.escape(full_title) + r'\.\s*', '', body.strip())
    body = re.sub(r'\b([A-D])\)', r'<b>\1)</b>', body)
    body = remap_table_refs(body)
    display_number = display_order.index(page_count) + 1
    body = f'<b>Figure S{display_number}: {escape(full_title)}.</b> ' + body
    c.setFont('Helvetica',8); c.setFillColor(colors.HexColor('#555555'))
    c.drawString(36,22,'Supplementary figures')
    c.drawRightString(W-36,22,str(display_number)); c.setFillColor(colors.black)
    if source:
        source=Path(source); record(source,'figure master')
        sr=PdfReader(source); readers.append(sr); rp=sr.pages[0]
        scale=min((W-72)/float(rp.mediabox.width), 490/float(rp.mediabox.height))
        x=(W-float(rp.mediabox.width)*scale)/2
        y=H-36-float(rp.mediabox.height)*scale
        prefix=out/f'review-source-{page_count+1}'
        subprocess.run(['/opt/homebrew/bin/pdftoppm','-f','1','-singlefile','-r','250','-png',str(source),str(prefix)],check=True,capture_output=True)
        c.drawImage(str(prefix)+'.png',x,y,width=float(rp.mediabox.width)*scale,height=float(rp.mediabox.height)*scale)
        para(c,body,36,y-15,W-72)
    elif draw:
        para(c,body,36,170,W-72)
    else:
        yy=H-72
        for line in body.split('\n\n'): yy=para(c,line,36,yy,W-72)
    if draw: draw(c)
    c.showPage(); page_count+=1

# Verify the unchanged accepted v1 return; never silently swap to v2.
v1=d/'16s_analysis/09_return_package'
v1check=[]
for r in rows(v1/'16s_return_package_manifest.tsv'):
    p=v1/r['file']; ok=p.is_file() and hashlib.md5(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['md5']
    v1check.append({'file':r['file'],'md5_matches':ok})
assert all(r['md5_matches'] for r in v1check if r['file']!='16s_return_summary.md'), 'Accepted v1 data or figure failed checksum verification'
# The local narrative summary differs from the archived hash. It is NOT an input
# to this assembly; preserve and expose the mismatch rather than altering it.
record(v1/'16s_return_package_manifest.tsv','v1 integrity manifest')

s1cap=text.split('Supplementary Figure 1:',1)[1].strip()
page('Figure S1. Original experiment',escape(s1cap),
     d/'figure1_s1_split_reuse_2026-09-15-v2/FigureS1-original-experiment.pdf')
page('Figure S2. Cross-omics community comparison',
     'A) Correspondence between Bray-Curtis dissimilarities for metagenomic (MG), '
     'metatranscriptomic (MT) and 16S rRNA profiles. Points represent the 66 sample pairs '
     'from 12 matched samples; ρ denotes Spearman correlation.<br/>'
     'B) Bray-Curtis dissimilarities between consecutive cleaning cycles within each condition '
     'and sampling phase. Colours identify control and treatment; symbols identify initial and backflush samples.<br/>'
     'C) Mean within-assay MG and MT read shares for selected MAGs. '
     'Concordance permutation tests and Benjamini-Hochberg-adjusted P values are reported in '
     'Supplementary Table S4; turnover and MAG read shares are in Tables S5 and S6.',
     d/'community_cross_omics_figure_2026-09-15-v3/figures/community_comparison.pdf')

page('Viral community composition',
     'Relative abundances of all 634 abundance-eligible vOTUs, grouped by viral realm. '
     'Bars sum to 100% within each sample and represent shares of vOTU-mapped metagenomic reads. '
     'Control and treatment are aligned by cleaning cycle and sampling phase (I, initial; BF, backflush). '
     'Unclassified sequences remain in the denominator. Colours identify viral realms and match '
     'the main community figure. Catalogue quality and taxonomy are reported in Supplementary Table S2.',
     d/'supplementary_votu_realm_bars_2026-09-22-v2/votu-realm-composition.pdf')

for file,title,caption in [
    ('16s-community-composition.pdf','16S rRNA community composition',
     'Family-level relative abundances from 16S rRNA-derived cDNA across 12 samples. '
     'Bars show control and treatment profiles for initial and backflush samples across three cleaning cycles.<br/>'
     'Colours identify families. Other classified families and sequences unclassified at family level '
     'are displayed separately; all categories contribute to the sample total.'),
    ('16s-community-ordination-bray_curtis.pdf','16S rRNA community structure: Bray-Curtis',
     'Principal-coordinate analysis of Bray-Curtis dissimilarities among 12 samples, based on '
     '16S rRNA amplicon sequence variant profiles. Axes 1 and 2 explain 45.1% and 17.4% of variation, respectively.<br/>'
     'Colours identify control and treatment; circles and triangles identify initial and backflush samples. '
     'Numbers indicate cleaning cycles. PERMANOVA results are reported in Supplementary Table S24.'),
    ('16s-community-ordination-aitchison.pdf','16S rRNA community structure: Aitchison',
     'Principal-coordinate analysis of Aitchison distances among 12 samples, based on '
     '16S rRNA amplicon sequence variant profiles. Axes 1 and 2 explain 29.2% and 15.9% of variation, respectively.<br/>'
     'Colours identify control and treatment; circles and triangles identify initial and backflush samples. '
     'Numbers indicate cleaning cycles. PERMANOVA results are reported in Supplementary Table S24.')]:
    page(title,caption,v1/file)

contributors=d/'figure4_functional_notation_2026-09-20-v4/tables/all_MAG_contributors.tsv'
rr=[r for r in rows(contributors) if r['set_id']=='biofilm_combined' and r['direction']=='Down in treatment']
assert len(rr)==22 and sum(int(r['genes']) for r in rr)==148
record(contributors,'combined biofilm downstream display data')
def bars(c):
    data=sorted(rr,key=lambda r:(-int(r['genes']),r['MAG_ID']))
    mx=max(int(r['genes']) for r in data)
    for i,r in enumerate(data):
        y=745-i*25
        sample,bin_id=r['MAG_ID'].split('_MAGScoT_cleanbin_')
        label=f"{r['genus'] or 'Unclassified'} {sample}/{int(bin_id)}"
        c.setFont('Helvetica',9); c.drawRightString(228,y,label)
        c.setFillColor(colors.HexColor('#71a76b'))
        c.rect(240,y-2,int(r['genes'])/mx*270,12,fill=1,stroke=0)
        c.setFillColor(colors.black); c.drawString(245+int(r['genes'])/mx*270,y,r['genes'])
    c.setFont('Helvetica',10); c.drawString(240,190,'Supported genes (count)')
page('Biofilm transcription: downregulated MAG contributors',
     'Distribution of 148 treatment-downregulated biofilm-associated genes across 22 MAGs. '
     'Bars indicate gene counts at whole-transcriptome FDR (BH) ≤ 0.05 and negative treatment log2 fold-change. '
     'Genes were identified using the combined 3,905-gene biofilm-associated set.<br/>'
     'Labels identify taxonomy and MAG identifiers. Gene membership and differential-expression results '
     'are reported in Supplementary Table S9; MAG-level gene counts are in Table S12.',draw=bars)

page('All 14 candidates: interval companion',
     'Model-implied changes in cleaning-performance score at 50% lower whole-MAG DNA abundance. '
     'Columns compare models adjusted for condition alone, condition and categorical cycle, '
     'or condition and linear cycle. Colours distinguish initial and backflush predictors.<br/>'
     'Points and whiskers show estimated changes and coefficient-based 95% confidence intervals '
     'for 14 MAGs carrying treatment-upregulated biofilm-associated genes. Each model contains six observations.<br/>'
     'Positive values indicate higher predicted cleaning scores, with other model terms held fixed. '
     'Model coefficients and suppression estimates are reported in Supplementary Tables S17 and S18.',
     d/'figure7_candidate_suppression_2026-09-15-v3/figures/figure7-interval-companion.pdf')
page('All-MAG model context',
     'Empirical cumulative distributions of predicted cleaning-score changes following a 50% reduction '
     'in the whole-MAG DNA abundance of each of 348 MAGs separately.<br/>'
     'Columns compare condition and categorical-cycle, condition-only, and condition and linear-cycle models. '
     'Rows distinguish backflush and initial predictors; each model contains six observations.<br/>'
     'Positive values indicate higher predicted cleaning scores. The vertical reference marks zero change. '
     'Individual-MAG model results are reported in Supplementary Table S19.',
     d/'cleaning_score_all_MAG_models_2026-09-21-v1/figures/all_MAG_reduction_distribution.pdf')

s1=d/'community_cross_omics_permutation_2026-09-16-v3/tables/bray_curtis_matrix_permutation_tests.tsv'
record(s1,'Table S1 results')
def table(c):
    data=[['Assays','Spearman rho','Global P','Global BH P','Restricted P','Restricted BH P']]
    for r in rows(s1): data.append([r['assay1']+' / '+r['assay2'],f"{float(r['spearman_rho']):.3f}"]+
                                 [f'{float(r[k]):.3g}' for k in ['global_p','global_q_BH','constrained_p','constrained_q_BH']])
    t=Table(data,colWidths=[70,77,70,80,80,90],rowHeights=26)
    t.setStyle(TableStyle([('FONTNAME',(0,0),(-1,0),'Helvetica-Bold'),('FONTSIZE',(0,0),(-1,-1),8),
                          ('BACKGROUND',(0,0),(-1,0),colors.HexColor('#eeeeee')),
                          ('LINEBELOW',(0,0),(-1,0),0.5,colors.black)]))
    t.wrapOn(c,520,200);t.drawOn(c,36,490)
pdf=out/'output/pdf/Supplementary_Figures.pdf'
review_canvas.save()
assembled = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(review_buffer.getvalue()))
for original_index in display_order:
    writer.add_page(assembled.pages[original_index])
with pdf.open('wb') as stream:
    writer.write(stream)
assert len(PdfReader(pdf).pages)==9
reader_text='\n'.join(p.extract_text() for p in PdfReader(pdf).pages)
for forbidden in ['v1', 'v2', 'AUTHOR REVIEW', 'source-data package', 'inherited master', 'author review']:
    assert forbidden not in reader_text, forbidden

# Preserve the old file inventory as review candidates, never mark all eligible by existence.
inventory=rows(d/'supplementary_manifest_2026-09-16-v1/supplementary_file_manifest.tsv')
for r in inventory:
    r['review_status']='NEEDS_SOURCE_RECONCILIATION'
    if r['table_label']=='S1': r['review_status']='RETAIN_TABLE_S1'
    if r['table_label']=='S13': r['review_status']='RECONCILE_TO_RETAINED_16S_V1'
    p=Path(r['absolute_path'])
    r['current_sha256_matches']=p.exists() and hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256']
(out/'inherited-file-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(inventory,indent=2))
(out/'source-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2))
(out/'16s-v1-integrity.json').write_text(json.dumps(v1check,indent=2))
(out/'BUILD_CHECKS.json').write_text(json.dumps({'pdf_pages':page_count,'v1_files_checked':len(v1check),
    'v1_all_match':all(r['md5_matches'] for r in v1check),'old_inventory_files':len(inventory),
    'old_inventory_all_match':all(r['current_sha256_matches'] for r in inventory),
    'live_document_modified':False,'status':'PARTIAL_AUTHOR_REVIEW_NOT_SUBMISSION'},indent=2))
print(pdf)
```
